def is_prime(n):
    """Return true if a given number is prime, and false otherwise.
    >>> is_prime(6)
    False
    >>> is_prime(101)
    True
    >>> is_prime(11)
    True
    >>> is_prime(13441)
    True
    >>> is_prime(61)
    True
    >>> is_prime(4)
    False
    >>> is_prime(1)
    False
    """
    # Handle edge cases: numbers less than 2 are not prime
    if n < 2:
        return False
    
    # 2 is the only even prime number
    if n == 2:
        return True
    
    # All other even numbers are not prime
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return False
    
    # Check odd divisors from 3 up to √n
    # If n has a divisor greater than √n, it must also have a divisor less than √n
    i = 3
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 2  # Only check odd numbers
    
    # If no divisors found, n is prime
    return True
